title: Author a policy standard
summary: Authors one subject-scoped policy standard from declared sources, explicit unknowns, and separately confirmed proposals without inventing organization law.

intent.goal: Prepare one provenance-complete policy standard whose given, found, proposed, and not-defined material remains mechanically distinguishable.
useWhen: One subject needs a new or expanded rules-first policy standard.
excludeWhen: Only schema drift, provider write mechanics, or a Process definition is in scope.

procedure.outcome: Resolve one subject and its existing registry record before deciding create versus expansion.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.

safeguards: Never infer organization policy from schema vocabulary alone.
Never hide proposals inside finished-looking prose or treat a batch approval as subject-level confirmation.
Never write before the complete decision and proposal lists are confirmed.
limitations: This definition declares workflow outcomes and boundaries; it does not itself grant execution, provider, publication, merge, or host-realization authority.
Behavior evidence and effects remain scoped to exact governed development requests and current workflow fingerprints.
